title: focus first error
name: Focus first error — Vercel
rule: On submit, move focus to the first field in error.
pass_when: After a failed submit, focus is on the first field in error.
fail_when: Focus stays on Submit or elsewhere, not the first error field.
overview: After a failed submit, move focus to the first field in error.
apply_when: Handling submit validation when one or more fields failed checks.
not_when: Inline blur validation that never involved a full-form submit.
agent_hint: On failed submit, move focus to the first invalid field, not Submit.
description: On submit, move focus to the first field in error so keyboard and screen-reader users land where repair starts instead of hunting. The submit control should not keep focus after a failed attempt. Apply when handling submit validation with one or more failing fields. Fail focus that stays on Submit or elsewhere instead of the first error field.
